summary: Three men reported lost and stranded without water or shelter on Mt. Neva (GPS ping relayed via Grand County dispatch); seven RMRG members hiked in overnight from the 4th of July Trailhead and walked them out by 5:15 a.m.; one mild altitude sickness, no other injuries
location: Mt. Neva, via 4th of July Trailhead
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group
notes: BCSO case 22-2887; call received ~7:52 p.m. June 20, RMRG started hike 11:00 p.m., returned 5:15 a.m.
